name: Dura-Ace shifter pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed weight for the complete left/right ST-R9170 hydraulic-disc dual-control lever pair: 320 g. The 2020 Shimano trade manual explicitly labels this as a pair weight; it is not a sum of separate controls or a complete caliper/hose/brake-system weight.

technical_document.title: Shimano ST-R9170 exploded view and replacement parts

sources.title: Shimano ST-R9170 exploded view and replacement parts

Shimano 2020 trade sales/support manual, printed/PDF p. 132: ST-R9170, 320 g explicitly per pair
